title: Clay Playbook: The Clay playbook nobody prints
caption:
The Clay playbook nobody prints

Audit yourself against this:
1️⃣ Start from a signal — 'Just raised funding' beats a static list — timing and relevance are most of the reply.
2️⃣ Pull 100+ sources — Role, tech stack, and recent activity attach to every row automatically — no manual Googling.
3️⃣ Reference their trigger — AI writes line one from the real event, not 'Hi {first_name}' filler that gets archived.
4️⃣ Send qualified only — Filters gate the sequencer. Unfit leads never touch your domain reputation.
